ranch-social.summary: A shared gathering place in Sterling Center with coffee, drinks, food, outdoor seating, a fire pit, and a log playground.
highlights: Atlas Coffee, Salta, Living the Dream Brewing Company, and Agora Market are presented here.
The official page describes covered patio seating, an outdoor fire pit, and a log playground.
Food trucks and community events are listed through the Sterling Ranch event calendar.
ranch-social.note: Event details and availability can change; use the official calendar for a particular date.

atlas-coffee.summary: Coffee, espresso and tea inside Ranch Social, with breakfast and lunch options.
highlights: The open, airy space welcomes a coffee break or a little remote work.
Share a stop with the taproom, market, patio and log playground.
Salta serves wine and cocktails at the same Sterling Ranch location.
atlas-coffee.note: Check the operator’s links for current offerings and visit details.

salta.summary: Salta is a wine and cocktail lounge at Atlas Coffee’s Sterling Ranch location.
highlights: At the same Sterling Ranch location as Atlas Coffee.
salta.note: Menus and service details can change; consult Salta’s official page before visiting.

living-dream.summary: Living the Dream’s Sterling Ranch taproom is in Sterling Center beside Atlas Coffee.
highlights: This is the Sterling Ranch satellite taproom.
Indoor and patio seating; dogs are allowed on the patio.
living-dream.note: The taplist and visit details are operator-managed; check the official links before making plans.

agora.summary: Agora is Atlas Coffee’s specialty market at its Sterling Ranch store.
highlights: Prepared meals, grocery staples and quick refreshments.
Specialty items, including local meat and dairy options.
agora.note: Product selection and prepared-food availability can change.

ranch-patio.summary: Ranch Social’s outdoor gathering area includes covered patio seating and a fire pit.
highlights: Covered seating overlooks the log playground.
An outdoor fire pit is part of the gathering space.
ranch-patio.note: This preview does not establish reservation, event, weather, or access conditions.

ranch-playground.summary: The Ranch Social log playground sits by the outdoor patio area.
highlights: Sculptural log play structures beside Ranch Social.
The covered patio overlooks the play area.
ranch-playground.note: This preview does not establish current play-area access, age guidance, or feature availability.

food-trucks.summary: Food trucks rotate through Ranch Social as part of its evening food and event offerings.
highlights: Ranch Social directs visitors to the day’s food truck through its event listings.
The official page describes a rotating range of food-truck cuisines.
The Sterling Ranch event calendar lists community happenings and event details.
food-trucks.note: Truck names, dates, and service details change; use the official calendar for the date you plan to visit.
